notes: The 25 percent threshold is the historical Social Doors/Doors exclusion rule and is applied cohort-wide here as a review flag, not an automatic exclusion.
A terminal failure candidate has at least five consecutive missed response opportunities at the end of a run.
A salvage review candidate has a terminal failure pattern, at least 40 percent of the expected trials before that pattern, and a preterminal miss fraction below 25 percent.
No functional image is trimmed and no run is approved or excluded by this audit.
